plan: Since this is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected payoff regardless of others' strategies. Other bidders being rational doesn't change this incentive. Tie-breaking is random but rare. I will bid my private value honestly to maximize long-run profit.

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy regardless of others' beliefs. Other bidders are rational and will likely bid their values, so truthful bidding maximizes my expected surplus and avoids overpaying. My private value is $34, so I will bid $34 (allowed $0.1 increments). This is robust to tie-breaking and the single-round setup.]

[In a sealed-bid, second-price auction with independent private values, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy. Other rational bidders anticipate this; bidding 45 maximizes my expected payoff: I win when the second-highest value <45 and pay that second-highest bid. I will bid 45.]
